profile_text.body:
Deere & Co is a public company headquartered in Moline, Illinois, and trades under the ticker DE. According to its website, it offers agricultural, construction, and forestry machinery, along with technology and services, and directs customers to find a John Deere dealer or purchase online.

The site text describes the company as spanning machinery, technology, and services across farming, construction, and forestry, but it does not name specific AI products or detail an AI position. No products are tracked for the company, and no MCP servers are listed.

The company's SEC filing record shows a CIK of 0000315189. It is recorded as facing 375 counts of law exposure in Illinois. No lawsuits are listed.
